damage.snapshot_status: Retained from the earlier 12:30 WIB BNPB update; the Ministry of Health report does not provide updated housing totals.

confirmed: The Ministry of Health situation report records 46 deaths and 113 injured people: 36 seriously injured and 77 with minor injuries.
A total population of 2,196,745 people is listed across eight affected regencies.
Manggarai recorded the highest reported deaths (21) and serious injuries (23); East Manggarai recorded 17 deaths.
The evacuee count remains under assessment in the latest report.
damage_reports: Detailed non-health damage counts remain based on the earlier 12:30 WIB BNPB update: 54 houses heavily damaged, 9 moderately damaged and 11 slightly damaged.
The latest Ministry of Health report provides separate operational and structural summaries for 21 hospitals and 190 puskesmas; these are presented in the health section.
One Bulog warehouse, three places of worship and six government offices were reported affected in the earlier BNPB snapshot.
Transport, road, electricity and telecommunications disruptions continue to be assessed by the responsible agencies.
information_gaps: Verified evacuee totals and evacuation-site distribution by district.
Reconciled casualty records across the Ministry of Health, BNPB, BPBD, Basarnas and district authorities.
Building-condition classification for six of the 190 puskesmas in the Ministry of Health source table.
Verified WASH, electricity, telecommunications, road and transport-service restoration status by district.
Post-disaster public-health and animal-health surveillance data and official monetary damage-and-loss estimates.
disclaimer: The Ministry of Health report is an official multi-agency field compilation dated 15 August 2026, but it does not state a specific data cut-off time. Figures remain preliminary and may change after reconciliation and validation.
